author: Haroen Viaene
subject: fix(removeNumericRefinement): clear empty refinements (algolia/algoliasearch-helper-js#801)
bodyLines: Previously this seemingly on purpose checked if this attrubte had refinements, but due to the way it is checking this, it will leave `{[attribute]: {}}` in the numeric refinements, which isn't what we want in e.g. a dispose.
